question: The Ministry of Labour & Employment launched ___________ under the Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan (PM-SYM) scheme in March 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Donate-a-Pension initiaive.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A program under the **Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan (PM-SYM) Yojana** is called **Donate-a-Pension.**
 
• It enables users to **donate the maximum amount** of their **direct support team.**
 
• These individuals could be your **housekeepers, chauffeurs, helpers, caregivers, etc.**
 
• The program is important because over **93% of all workers **in the nation are employed in the **unorganized sector.**
 
• Depending on the** beneficiary's age,** donations can be made for as little as** Rs 660 or as much as Rs 2,400.**
 
• The** minimal contribution** for those who wish to donate is** one year.**
 
• After a subscriber reaches th**e age of 60,** they are eligible to receive a pension of at least** Rs 3,000 per month.**
 
• The spouse will be eligible to** receive 50% **of the beneficiary's pension if the subscriber passes away while they are receiving it.
 
• If a **subscriber passes away before turning 60,** the surviving spouse may join and carry on the plan by making successive regular contributions.
 
• He or she is allowed to **exit the scheme **as per provisions of **exit and withdrawal.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Stand-Up India scheme:**

 
 
• The Government of India introduced Stand-Up India on** April 5, 2016.**
 
• In order to establish a **Greenfield Projec**t, the Stand-Up India scheme aims to make bank loans between **10 lakh and 1 crore** available to at least **one SC or ST borrower** and **one woman borrower **each bank branch.
 
 
 
• **Atal Pension Yojana:**
 
 
• To establish a **universal social security system **for all Indians, particularly the** poor, the underprivileged**, and those working in the** unorganized sector, **the Atal Pension Yojana (APY) was introduced on** May 9, 2015.**
 
• At the **age of 60, **subscribers will start receiving the **guaranteed minimum monthly pension **of **Rs. 1000, Rs. 2000, Rs. 3000, Rs. 4000, or Rs. 5000.**
 
 
 
• **India Water Pitch-Pilot-Scale Start-up Challenge:**
 
 
• India Water Pitch-Pilot-Scale Start-up **AMRUT 2.0 **established a challenge to** promote creativity and design**.
 
• The purpose is to **enable startups** in the water and **used-water sectors** to **expand via innovation and design**, which will** provide employment opportunities** and support economic growth.
